entities.summary: A coin hoard discovered in the vicinity of kabul, afghanistan in 1933 that contained numerous achaemenid coins as well as many greek coins from the 5th and 4th centuries bce  349 BCE. Kabul hoard is a archaeological site from Asia, created circa 349 BCE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
